name: The Market Place
description: The Market Place is Orange County's most comprehensive shopping, dining and lifestyle destination, featuring a trend-forward mix of lifestyle brands, health & beauty boutiques, home improvement stores, and specialty grocers. This expansive open-air center elevates everyday shopping with its diverse tenant mix spanning fashion, food & beverage, health & fitness, and services under the Southern California sun.
summary: OC's premier open-air lifestyle destination offering the best of everything from shopping and dining to health and wellness.
